updates.title: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP has reached general availability for monitoring sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols from managed Windows devices, with enforcement capabilities to prevent exfiltration. Admins can now configure FTP and SFTP activities directly in Endpoint DLP policies to protect data in transit across these legacy but still-common transfer methods.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Integrates with Entra Global Secure Access for Network-Layer DLP
updates.summary: Purview Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce DLP policies at the network layer, protecting text, files, and AI interactions across browsers, apps, APIs, and untrusted cloud applications. This integration enables detection of risky user activity through Insider Risk Management and prevents sensitive data leakage to social media, collaborative platforms, and generative AI services.

updates.title: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Reporting Now Available
updates.summary: A new compliance reporting feature for Microsoft Purview Information Barriers policies allows admins to identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers that have drifted out of compliance following policy changes. This enables systematic auditing and remediation of Information Barriers violations across the organization.
